text:
incident-bot: P2 alert — ingestion path error rate rising in us-west. 503s for ~15% of embedding requests, median latency -> 1.8s. Pager triggered (ts: 1749999999).

sre-maya: ack — joining. creating ops room & collecting owner.

sre-maya: ops room https://meet.redwood/ops/1749999999 (warroom) :wave:

ben-platform: taking owner for ingestion pipeline. assigning myself to mitigation. :white_check_mark:

carol-support: noted. compiling customer impact now — will post list in 2m.

ben-platform: quick plan: 1) scale ingest-workers 2x, 2) enable client backpressure (throttle new ingest requests), 3) failover to fallback embedding model for dedicated customers if needed.

dinesh-eng: running restart of the autoscaler & workers now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/ingest-workers --replicas=40
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/ingest-workers
```

oncall-sre: please add the small runbook snippet to thread so support can read quick ops steps. also capture any config flags toggled.

ben-platform: runbook excerpt: check queue depth via `metric:ingest.queue_length`, tail logs `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=ingest-workers --tail=200` and watch `ingest-errors` graph in console. If queue depth > 5000, enable backpressure: `POST /admin/throttle?rate=0.5`.

carol-support: customers impacted (prelim):
- acme-ai (dedicated, high QPS) — intermittent 503s, non-blocking for now
- builderly (hosted) — elevated latencies, some 503s on bulk ingest jobs
- internal test org — noisy but not customer-critical

carol-support: drafting status page/notification now. suggested status page copy: "Investigating elevated error rate for embedding ingestion in US-West. Mitigations are being applied; we will update within 15 minutes." Approve?

sre-maya: approve that status copy. add ETA for next update: 15m.

ben-platform: mitigation step 1/3 completed — replicas scaled, CPU pressure dropping. seeing reduced 503s from 15% -> ~9% in last 90s.

deploy-bot: deployment event: autoscaler config bumped (user: ben-platform) — rollout started (id: deploy-1749999999).

oncall-sre: request — can ops confirm whether KV cache hit rate changed? if cache pressure increased it could explain latency spikes.

ben-platform: checking kv-cache metrics — hit rate steady. looks ingestion worker queue saturation was main driver.

carol-support: status page updated (draft published to internal stage). customer note queued: "We are investigating intermittent failures for embedding ingestion in US-West. Mitigation in progress; updates to follow."

dinesh-eng: running logs grep to validate error surface: `grep -E "5.. .*ingest" /var/log/ingest/ingest-*.log | tail -n 200` — most 503s map to short GC pauses on specific host group. rolling restart addressing that.

ben-platform: enabling client-side throttling gate for hosted tier (non-blocking for dedicated customers). command: `POST https://internal-api/ingest/admin/throttle` body `{"rate":0.7}`. send me any failures.

carol-support: support -> customer comms plan: if 503s drop below 5% in 10m, we'll send an FYI to affected customers. if not, escalate to an incident advisory.

oncall-sre: please confirm who will own postmortem/communications once stabilized.

ben-platform: I'll own post-incident notes and mitigation timeline. cc @dinesh-eng for infra details.

sre-maya: succinct checklist for warroom:
- owner: ben-platform
- warroom link posted
- support lead: carol-support (customer comms)
- mitigation actions: scaled workers, throttle gate, rolling restart
- metrics to watch: ingest.queue_length, ingest.errors(503), kvcache.hit_rate, p50/p95 latencies

carol-support: acknowledged. I'll prepare the customer email and the statuspage update for the external page.

ben-platform: current numbers: 503s down to 4.8% global for us-west, p95 latency 700ms. continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: Pager resolved (resolved_by: ben-platform, ts: 1750000055).

sre-maya: nice work team. keep monitoring for 30m. if stable, we close and move to retrospective. :tada:

carol-support: will send customer FYI in 10m if no regression.

ben-platform: filing follow-up ticket with root cause analysis and rollout notes.

sre-maya: logging this thread into incident tracker and marking initiated-by-pager-bot.

end of thread.
